headline: MIN @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.32 at PIT 3.73, with a projected total of 7.05. The cold/risk list flags James Outman, Henry Davis because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
